scope: WebMail account safety, recipient directory, bounded administration, explicit Trash deletion, and integration review
environment: Local development host and Docker PostgreSQL; fictional fixtures and simulated providers

server_sqlite.skip_reason: Existing tests for disabled registration, email verification, and email-based password recovery features

server_postgresql.database_verification_command: rtk proxy docker compose exec -T -e APP_ENV=testing -e DB_DATABASE=webmail_test app php -r 'require "vendor/autoload.php"; $app = require "bootstrap/app.php"; $app->make(\Illuminate\Contracts\Console\Kernel::class)->bootstrap(); fwrite(STDOUT, \Illuminate\Support\Facades\DB::scalar("select current_database()").PHP_EOL);'
server_postgresql.command: rtk proxy docker compose exec -T -e APP_ENV=testing -e DB_DATABASE=webmail_test app php artisan test --compact
server_postgresql.isolation: Verified current_database() in the exact environment before the suite; main webmail database was not migrated or reset

worker.environment: Local Miniflare and SQLite-backed D1 emulation; not deployed Cloudflare

static_analysis.note: Debug mode runs without the parallel worker socket restricted by the host sandbox

formatting_at_time_of_backend_check.note: Backend-slice files passed their scoped Pint check; the three integration files were still being edited by their owners

observations: Search uses a bound LIKE pattern within the selected authorized mailbox and excludes Spam/Trash unless explicitly selected.
Conversations are scoped to the authorized mailbox, ordered by created_at and id, and bounded to 30 messages per page.
Original MIME export checks mailbox membership, uses a numeric attachment filename, preserves bytes, and disables caching; administrator role does not grant mailbox access.

AuthenticateSession preserves the updated current-session password hash while stale password sessions are rejected; account safety tests also exercise database-session deletion and actual remembered-cookie replay.
Passkey login policy rejects owner/admin and suspended accounts, retaining the administrator password/TOTP boundary. Hardware authenticator behavior was not exercised.

limitations.main_database: not migrated, reset, or used for test fixtures
